svg.title: SEPT Lab vision: trustworthy computing, from hardware to AI agents
svg.desc: Four isometric layers rise from bottom left to top right. I Hardware: a chip whose gold enclave holds a red root of trust. II Systems: three virtual machines on a hypervisor; the middle one is gold, a confidential VM, and a red crack splits the one on the right, a vulnerability. III Models: a small neural network whose red inference path ends in a gold output node marked with a check. IV Agents: a gold agent block marked with the AI spark, linked to a tool isolated in a wireframe cage. Gold marks what is protected on each layer; one red thread, the chain of trust, rises from the root of trust through every gold element to the agent.
